title: Season of the Sandstorms
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie ride camels to the golden age of Baghdad to deliver a book of wisdom. 杰克和安妮骑着骆驼来到黄金时代的巴格达，送出一册充满智慧的书！🐪

q.en: What are the names of the two camel sisters Jack and Annie ride?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮骑的那两匹骆驼姊妹叫什么名字？

options.en: Rosie and Star, a pair of old gray donkeys
options.zh: 罗茜和星星，一对老灰驴，不过那是另一个故事了

options.en: Sandy and Dusty, two desert ponies
options.zh: 沙沙和尘尘，两匹沙漠小马

options.en: Max and Ruby, the merchant's horses
options.zh: 马克斯和露比，商人的马

options.en: Cutie and Beauty, the two camel sisters
options.zh: 小可爱和美人，两匹骆驼姊妹

explain.en: Annie names the two kneeling camel sisters: 'Hey, Cutie,' she says to one, and 'Hey, Beauty,' to the other. She pats their 'wiry, tan-colored fur.'
explain.zh: 安妮给跪着的两匹骆驼姊妹起了名字：对着一匹说“嘿，小可爱”，对着另一匹说“嘿，美人”。她还拍了拍它们土黄色的粗毛。

q.en: In Merlin's letter, what is the 'ship of the desert'?
q.zh: 在梅林的信里，“沙漠之舟”指的是什么？

options.en: A large sailboat sailing the wide Tigris River
options.zh: 在宽阔的底格里斯河上航行的大帆船

options.en: A camel that crosses the sand
options.zh: 穿越黄沙的骆驼

options.en: A wooden cart pulled by donkeys
options.zh: 驴子拉的大木车

options.en: A magic flying carpet from Baghdad
options.zh: 来自巴格达的魔法飞毯

explain.en: When Mamoon says 'We love our ships of the desert, too,' Annie whispers, 'So that's what "ships of the desert" are!' — and they climb onto the camels.
explain.zh: 马蒙说“我们也爱我们的沙漠之舟”，安妮小声说“原来‘沙漠之舟’就是这个！”——然后他们就骑上了骆驼。

q.en: What is inside the wooden treasure box Mamoon protects with his life?
q.zh: 马蒙用生命保护的那个木宝盒里，装的是什么？

options.en: A pile of precious rubies
options.zh: 一堆珍贵的红宝石

options.en: Several heavy bags of pepper and bright painted beads
options.zh: 好几袋沉重的胡椒和鲜艳的彩绘珠子

options.en: A book of Aristotle's wisdom
options.zh: 一本亚里士多德智慧之书

options.en: Gold coins from the bazaar
options.zh: 集市上得来的金币

explain.en: When Jack pries the box open, 'Inside the box was a book,' with the words THE WRITINGS OF ARISTOTLE on the first page. Mamoon calls it a priceless treasure.
explain.zh: 杰克撬开盒子，“里面是一本书”，扉页上写着《亚里士多德的著作》。马蒙说这是无价之宝。

q.en: Which magic rhyme brings the camel caravan to Jack and Annie in the desert?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮在沙漠里用了哪条魔法韵文，把驼队引了过来？

options.en: Make a Stone Come Alive to help
options.zh: 让石头活过来帮忙

options.en: Turn into a flock of loud quacking ducks
options.zh: 变成一群呱呱大叫的鸭子

options.en: Make Helpers Appear from Nowhere
options.zh: 让帮手从“无处”现身

options.en: Bend the Iron of the Saddle
options.zh: 弯折马鞍上的铁

explain.en: In the oasis ('nowhere'), Annie picks 'Make Helpers Appear out of Nowhere.' A sandstorm comes and brings Mamoon's caravan — the helpers they needed.
explain.zh: 在绿洲（“无处”）里，安妮选了“让帮手从无处现身”。一阵沙暴过后，马蒙的驼队正好赶到——正是他们需要的帮手。

q.en: Which rhyme fixes the book of wisdom after Beauty the camel chews it?
q.zh: 骆驼美人把智慧书咬坏后，用了哪条韵文把它修好？

options.en: Mend What Cannot Be Mended
options.zh: 修补无法修补的东西

options.en: Find a Treasure That You Must Never Lose
options.zh: 找到绝不能丢失的宝物

options.en: Spin into the Air
options.zh: 旋转飞上天空

options.en: Make Metal Soft
options.zh: 让金属变软

explain.en: Beauty chews the book to shreds, so Jack uses 'Mend What Cannot Be Mended.' The torn pages swirl up and reform into the whole, unbroken book.
explain.zh: 美人把书咬得粉碎，于是杰克用了“修补无法修补的东西”。碎页打着旋飞起，重新拼成一本完好无损的书。

q.en: What is the 'House of Wisdom' that Caliph al-Mamoon shows Jack and Annie?
q.zh: 哈伦·马蒙哈里发带杰克和安妮去看的“智慧宫”是什么？

options.en: A library for the whole world
options.zh: 一座面向全世界的图书馆

options.en: A zoo with a hundred lions
options.zh: 养着一百头狮子的动物园

options.en: A market selling spices and silk
options.zh: 贩卖香料和丝绸的集市

options.en: A grand palace topped with a glittering green dome
options.zh: 顶端闪着绿光圆顶的宏伟宫殿

explain.en: The caliph says 'Welcome to the House of Wisdom, a learning center for the entire world,' with a library, an observatory, and a laboratory for medicines.
explain.zh: 哈里发说“欢迎来到智慧宫，一座面向全世界的学问中心”，里面有图书馆、天文台，还有研制药物的研究室。

q.en: What is the 'horse on a dome, the one who sees all' that Merlin's letter mentions?
q.zh: 梅林信里说的“圆顶上的马，洞察一切的那匹”是什么？

options.en: A flying horse from Arabian tales
options.zh: 阿拉伯故事里那匹会飞的马

options.en: A real horse kept in the caliph's royal stable
options.zh: 养在哈里发皇家马厩里的一匹真马

options.en: A horse statue on the dome
options.zh: 圆顶上一尊马的雕像

options.en: A soldier riding through the city
options.zh: 一个骑马穿过城市的士兵

explain.en: At the heart of the city, a palace looms 'with a glittering green dome. At the top of the dome stood the statue of a horse' — the 'horse who sees all.'
explain.zh: 在城中心，一座宫殿“顶着闪亮的绿圆顶。圆顶之上立着一尊马的雕像”——正是那匹“洞察一切的马”。

q.en: Who perfected the way of writing numbers that we now call Arabic numerals?
q.zh: 谁完善了我们现在称为“阿拉伯数字”的记数法？

options.en: al-Kindi, perhaps the greatest scientist alive
options.zh: 或许是世界上最伟大科学家的阿尔·肯迪

options.en: Aristotle, a Greek philosopher
options.zh: 希腊哲学家亚里士多德

options.en: al-Khwarizmi the mathematician
options.zh: 数学家阿尔·花拉子米

options.en: Mamoon, the camel merchant
options.zh: 骆驼商人马蒙

explain.en: The caliph points to al-Khwarizmi and says he 'has perfected the Indian way of writing numbers,' the 1–10 numerals we call Arabic numerals today.
explain.zh: 哈里发指着阿尔·花拉子米，说他“完善了印度的记数法”——也就是我们今天称为阿拉伯数字的1到10。

q.en: What causes the mysterious 'whistling sands' sound in the desert?
q.zh: 沙漠里神秘的“会唱歌的沙”声音是怎么来的？

options.en: Sands shifting as they settle
options.zh: 沙粒在沉降时移动摩擦

options.en: Ghosts of lost desert travelers
options.zh: 迷路旅人留下的鬼魂

options.en: A magic spell from the caliph
options.zh: 哈里发施下的魔法

options.en: Birds singing softly in the date palm trees
options.zh: 在椰枣树里低声歌唱的鸟儿

explain.en: Mamoon says he likes science: 'We have learned the whistling is made by sands settling in the drifts.' He believes nature has reasons, not just magic.
explain.zh: 马蒙说他喜欢科学：“我们了解到，那呜呜声是沙粒在沙丘里沉降时发出来的。”他认为大自然自有其道理，不全是魔法。

q.en: How do Jack and Annie fly back to the tree house at the end of the mission?
q.zh: 任务结束时，杰克和安妮是坐着什么飞回树屋的？

options.en: On a magic flying carpet
options.zh: 一张会飞的魔法地毯

options.en: In the caliph's royal carriage
options.zh: 坐在哈里发的皇家马车里

options.en: On a giant golden eagle
options.zh: 骑在一只巨大的金鹰上

options.en: On the backs of their two camel sisters
options.zh: 骑在他们那两匹骆驼姊妹的背上

explain.en: Using the 'Fly Through the Air' rhyme, a carpet in the library lifts off and carries them out the window, soaring all the way back to the oasis tree house.
explain.zh: 他们用了“飞上天空”的韵文，图书馆里的一块地毯飞了起来，载着他们飞出窗外，一路回到绿洲里的树屋。
